newsitem.title: MACAU: Liu Chong Hing Bank wins Macau licence.
newsitem.headline: Liu Chong Hing Bank wins Macau licence.

text.p: The Macau Monetary and Foreign Exchange Authority said on Tuesday it had granted a full banking licence to Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd of Hong Kong.
This brings to 23 the number of fully-licensed banks in Macau, it said.
The total assets of Macau's banking sector totalled 129.7 billion patacas (US$16.2 billion) in August 1996.

Liu Chong Hing Bank, 53.68 percent owned by Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd, provides banking, financial and related services. It has a head office and 32 branches in Hong Kong, one branch in the United States and one branch in China.
